name: BODHI Health Lab
tagline: Biomedical Ontology & Digital Health Informatics Lab
description: BODHI Health Lab connects biomedical ontology, digital health, and public health research to build practical, data-informed solutions for communities.
aboutDescription: BODHI Health Lab brings together researchers, students, and collaborators to develop trustworthy health data, ontology, and digital tools for community health.
